hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; is_nvim=0; for tok in $cmd; do if [ "$tok" = "nvim" ]; then is_nvim=1; fi; done; if [ "$is_nvim" = "1" ] && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'env -u NVIM'; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"nvim invoked without env -u NVIM. This repos flatten.nvim would route it into the users live nvim instance via $NVIM instead of an isolated one (see nvim/.config/nvim/CLAUDE.md). Re-issue with env -u NVIM prefixed."}}'; fi; }
hooks.statusMessage: Checking nvim invocation for flatten.nvim safety...
